packageRules.description: Auto tier: stateless apps auto-merge safe updates (pin/digest/patch/minor). Majors still fall through to the major rule below.
0.x images: a minor bump (0.y) can be breaking under semver, so review it by hand instead of auto-merging. Patches still auto-merge.
Major versions are never auto-merged: open a PR only after I approve it on the dependency dashboard.

Frozen data layer: Postgres, valkey/redis and all Immich images move only after manual review (Postgres majors need pg_upgrade; Immich ships breaking migrations). No PR until approved on the dashboard.
Disruptive / config-sensitive: media servers and the VPN download stack get a normal PR but never auto-merge — merge by hand to avoid mid-stream restarts or a broken killswitch.

Plex patch releases DO auto-merge, overriding the rule above. Plex is the only internet-facing service with no reverse proxy, WAF or CrowdSec in front of it, so its patch latency is a security property. Minor and major still require a manual merge.

Public ingress edge. A bad update to any of these takes every public hostname offline at once and is awkward to diagnose from outside the network, so they get a normal PR and never auto-merge. Paperless is included because it runs database migrations on start.
